importantFindings.title: Boat numbers of 3+ characters collide with the first name in the read view and the PNG
importantFindings.evidence: CrewManagement.tsx fixed w-[26px] number column with text-xl digits; crewSummaryImage.ts CARD_NUMBER_COLUMN_WIDTH 92 with a 54px font. Rendered numbers 115, 888, 1234, A12: '115Anna Verdi' touches, '1234' prints over the name. normalizeBoatNumber allows any length; tests used numbers 1..13 only.
importantFindings.impact: The number the instructor scans for runs into the first name on screen and in the shared image. No person dropped.

importantFindings.title: The warning badge and the width estimate hide names in the image; possible overlap on screen
importantFindings.evidence: crewSummaryImage.ts draws a 44px warning badge over the first name row; estimateTextWidth (0.58em per character) under-measures capitals: 'FRANCESCA BIANCHI' on a warned card is partly covered, 'WWWW…' runs past the card. On screen the 16px corner badge can cover the last 12px of a full-width first line.
importantFindings.impact: A name on a warned crew can be partly unreadable in the exported image.

importantFindings.title: The exporter has no canvas size guard
importantFindings.evidence: summaryImage.ts always rasterises at pixelRatio 2: 45 four-person crews give a 16284 px tall canvas (35M pixels); iOS Safari caps a canvas at about 16.7M pixels.
importantFindings.impact: Not a regression (the pre-F3 exporter had the same fixed 2x); a large course could give a blank image or the download error on an iPhone.

importantFindings.title: Product spec §7.5 was not reconciled with the new summary
importantFindings.evidence: Spec §7.5 and the UX1 changelog: the summary starts with remaining available students, a centered 'Tutti gli allievi assegnati' note closes it when none remain, and a boat-less crew in a one-model session reads '<model> · Senza barca'. F3 moved available people after the crews, dropped the note and put that crew under 'Equipaggi senza barca'.
importantFindings.impact: Three silent semantic changes against an owner-approved spec (AGENTS.md §2).

importantFindings.title: No test asserts that the Comandate scroll lock is released
importantFindings.evidence: DutyManagement.tsx saves and restores html/body overflow; the code is correct today but no test checks it after closing, Escape or unmount.
importantFindings.impact: A later edit could leak overflow:hidden and freeze scrolling unnoticed.
